have hn := yui_aux_0010 p l K V act x y h v0 M h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_H005 h_T002 h_T004 h_T007 h_T008 r hr

have he := congrArg (fun q : Module.End ℤ M => q.baseChange K) hi

rw [yui_aux_0011 p l K V act x y h v0 M h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_H005 h_T002 h_T004 h_T007 h_T008, Int.cast_natCast] at he

  [modV : _root_.Module ℂ V] (act : ↥Reduction.SL →ₗ⁅ℂ⁆ End ℂ V) (x y h : ↥Reduction.SL) (v0 : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  Nat.Prime p →
    CharP K p →
      0 ≤ l ∧ l < ↑p →
        Reduction.chevalley x y h →
          Reduction.basisFacts l (act x) (act y) (act h) v0 →
            Reduction.localizationFacts p l (act x) (act y) (act h) v0 M →
              Reduction.commonFacts p l (act y) v0 M →
                Reduction.scalarFacts p K M →
                  ∀ (f g : End ℤ ↥M) (F : End ℂ V) (r : ℕ),
                    (∀ (m : ↥M), ↑(f m) = F ↑m) →
                      (∀ (m : ↥M), ↑(g m) = (Reduction.divided F r) ↑m) →
                        r ≤ l.toNat → LinearMap.baseChange K g = (↑r.factorial)⁻¹ • LinearMap.baseChange K f ^ r
